experience.description: During my  Internship at LMKR, I specialized in building enterprise grade WebGIS applications and managing spatial data architecture. I designed and optimized relational spatial database schemas, executing complex SQL and CQL spatial queries to power GIS workflows. On the development front, I engineered responsive user interfaces using Angular to render spatial geometries interactively on the web, paired with custom Python (GeoPandas) backend services and REST APIs. Additionally, I enhanced enterprise geospatial infrastructure security by implementing JWT based authentication for GeoServer services.

experience.description:
During my internship at The Map Ventures, I collaborated with a developer team to build a comprehensive cross-platform travel and tourism product, spanning both mobile and web applications. Key technical contributions included:

Backend & API Architecture: Designed and deployed scalable REST APIs using FastAPI, establishing fast, asynchronous communication between application interfaces and server data.

Spatial Data Management: Provisioned and managed cloud spatial databases using Supabase and PostGIS to store, index, and query location-based travel content efficiently.

Cross-Platform Mobile Development: Worked on frontend application features using Flutter to deliver responsive user experiences for mobile and web users.
